name: discovery-interview-planner
description: Plans the customer conversations an innovation initiative needs before anything is built (who to talk to, how many, the interview guide, consent, the note template, and synthesis into evidence entries), part of the Innovation Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run discovery-interview-planner", "plan problem interviews", "who should we talk to before we build this", "write the interview guide", "synthesize the interviews", or when an idea is about to enter stage one and nobody has spoken to a customer yet. Use it even for "should we ask some clients about this".
